MyForeverBaby · South Africa

Supplier Specification and Quotation Request

We are a South African retailer of lifelike baby dolls. We are appointing a manufacturing partner for our full range. This document shows every doll we buy, what it must look like, and how many units we need. Please quote against it.

Issued 12 August 2026 · Delivery to Johannesburg, South Africa · 303 dolls over three deliveries
303Dolls in this request
17Models across 6 sculpt groups
185Units on one single sculpt
3Deliveries to end December

What we need from you

Please answer these five points. A short reply is fine. You do not need to quote every model to be considered, but tell us clearly which ones you can make.

  1. Unit price at 50, 100 and 200 units Quote per sculpt group. Please state whether the price is ex works or FOB, and name the port.
  2. Minimum order quantity Per model, and per colour or outfit variation if that differs.
  3. Lead time to Johannesburg, South Africa, including freight Production time and shipping time separately. Please quote both air and sea if you offer them.
  4. OEM packaging and branding Can you supply our own printed box, our own labels, and a printed birth certificate inside the box?
  5. Safety certification Please confirm which of EN71, ASTM F963 and ISO9001 you hold, and send the certificates.

Quantities and delivery windows

Quantities are firm for the first delivery and indicative for the second and third. We would rather place three scheduled orders than one large order.

Specification points we need you to confirm

We would rather raise these now than receive the wrong doll. Please answer each one in your quotation.

  1. Baby Samantha, finished length. Our own product listing says 47 to 49 cm. The sculpt in the photograph is a larger toddler that matches 22 inch, roughly 55 cm. Please quote the doll in the photograph and state the length you supply.
  2. Baby Hannah, sleeping sculpt. Please work from the photograph only. Quote a sleeping doll with closed eyes and confirm the finished length.
  3. Cloth body range, Group 5. We do not currently hold verified dimensions for these five dolls. Please state the finished length and the weight of what you supply, and confirm the body is a weighted cloth body with vinyl head and limbs.
  4. Colour and paint consistency. Several models share one sculpt. We need the skin tone and face paint to match across a production run and between repeat orders. Please describe how you control this.
  5. Samples. We would like to order samples of the Group 1 sculpt and the Group 5 cloth body before committing to a production order. Please quote sample cost and sample lead time.
